sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "nodes" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "parent_id" TEXT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "body_md" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "body_format" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'md_lww', "child_view" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'open', "completed_by" TEXT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NULL, "priority" INTEGER NULL, "estimate_minutes" INTEGER NULL, "start_at" TEXT NULL, "end_at" TEXT NULL, "time_zone" TEXT NULL, "due_at" TEXT NULL, "due_date" TEXT NULL, "rrule" TEXT NULL, "repeat_start" TEXT NULL, "exclusive_children" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("exclusive_children" IN (0, 1)), "shared_with_children" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("shared_with_children" IN (0, 1)), "lifecycle" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'live', "lifecycle_at" TEXT NULL, "lifecycle_root_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "node_search" USING fts5(title, body_md, content=nodes, content_rowid=rowid, tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');
CREATE TRIGGER nodes_search_insert AFTER INSERT ON nodes BEGIN INSERT INTO node_search ("rowid", title, body_md) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title, new.body_md);END
CREATE TRIGGER nodes_search_delete AFTER DELETE ON nodes BEGIN INSERT INTO node_search (node_search, "rowid", title, body_md) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title, old.body_md);END

CREATE TRIGGER nodes_search_update AFTER UPDATE OF title, body_md ON nodes BEGIN INSERT INTO node_search (node_search, "rowid", title, body_md) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title, old.body_md);INSERT INTO node_search ("rowid", title, body_md) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title, new.body_md);END
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachment_search" USING fts5(attachment_id UNINDEXED, filename, content, tokenize='unicode61 remove_diacritics 2');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "users" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "identity_public_key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spaces" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "root_node_id" TEXT NULL, "merged_into_space_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "space_members" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "joined_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"), UNIQUE ("space_id", "user_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "occurrence_completions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurrence_date" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "completed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "placements" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "parent_node_id" TEXT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "links" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "from_node_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_id" TEXT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "core_values" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "statement" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "color" INTEGER NULL, "icon" TEXT NULL, "sort_key" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "node_values" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_id" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "favorite" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("favorite" IN (0, 1)), "kept" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("kept" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "node_tags" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "tag_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "attachments" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "content_hash" TEXT NOT NULL, "filename" TEXT NOT NULL, "mime" TEXT NOT NULL, "size_bytes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "width" INTEGER NULL, "height" INTEGER NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "annotations" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "attachment_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "color" INTEGER NOT NULL, "z" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "reminders" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "minutes_before" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "node_user_prefs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_by" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("deleted" IN (0, 1)), "node_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "ics_export" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("ics_export" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "change_log" ("op_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "space_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "table_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "column_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, "hlc" TEXT NOT NULL, "origin_device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "author_user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "schema_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("op_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "devices" ("device_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "device_public_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "signed_by_user_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "label" TEXT NULL, "is_this_device" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_this_device" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("device_id"));
CREATE INDEX nodes_parent_sort ON nodes (parent_id, sort_key)
CREATE INDEX placements_parent ON placements (parent_node_id, sort_key)
CREATE INDEX placements_node ON placements (node_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX links_unique ON links (from_node_id, target_kind, target_id) WHERE deleted = 0
CREATE INDEX links_target ON links (target_kind, target_id)
CREATE INDEX node_values_node ON node_values (node_id)
CREATE INDEX node_values_value ON node_values (value_id)
CREATE INDEX node_tags_node ON node_tags (node_id)
CREATE INDEX node_tags_tag ON node_tags (tag_id)
CREATE INDEX attachments_node ON attachments (node_id)
CREATE INDEX annotations_attachment ON annotations (attachment_id)
CREATE INDEX reminders_node ON reminders (node_id)
CREATE INDEX node_user_prefs_node ON node_user_prefs (node_id)
CREATE INDEX occurrence_completions_node ON occurrence_completions (node_id, occurrence_date)
CREATE INDEX change_log_hlc ON change_log (hlc)
CREATE INDEX change_log_field ON change_log (table_name, row_id, column_name)
